content:
The Boss resets every week at Thursday 1 AM (GMT+1) ! 

You can fight the Boss daily to improve your run or get additional rewards like Trophies!

Every Pin works and does exactly what it says - e.g.  5 Stars,  Max Trophies 
  - Pins are read from left to right, top to bottom. 1, 2, 3 corresponds to the different actions your Character can make! -> 1 means top choice, 2 means middle choice, 3 means bottom choice
  - Pins might be inaccurate in the first few hours of a new Boss!

Every Pinned message is tested with a 10 Character Account! 

If a Pinned message does not give you 5 Skulls it means you need to work on your Account -> Skilling levels, Class level, Material Capacity and Number of Kills are the requirements a Boss can have!

Trophies and Shop

The Weekly Boss has 5 Difficulties indicated by the 5 Skulls. 
Each skull beaten gives Trophies: Skull 1: 6 Trophies; Skull 2,3,4: 7 Trophies each; Skull 5: 8 Trophies
Note: You only get those Skulls one time each week

Additional Trophies can be obtained by choosing Misc options during Bossfights! 
  -> Not every week will have a good way to farm Trophies

Shop:
Best Items to buy: Gold Pocketwatch for 30 Trophies and Trophy Star Talent Book for 25 Trophies -> Not Death Star Talent Book
Note: Other Items can be bought, but are not optimal

**Weekly Bosses: Useful Information**

The Boss resets every week at **Thursday 1 AM (UTC+1) !** 

You can fight the Boss daily to improve your run or get additional rewards like Trophies!

**Every** Pin works and does exactly what it says - e.g.  5 Stars,  Max Trophies 
-> Misc Stats (Damage & Class XP) may vary from the pinned values, since the bonus is based on your Account stats
- Pins are read from left to right, top to bottom. 1, 2, 3 corresponds to the different actions your Character can make! -> 1 means top choice, 2 means middle choice, 3 means bottom choice
- Example: 1 2 3 - 2 3 3
                     1 1 2 - 2 1 3 
**->** Choose Top choice (1), Middle choice (2), Bottom choice (3), Middle choice (2), Bottom choice (3), Bottom choice (3) -> Go down a line and repeat till you are at the end of the List
- "FR" (Full Rewind) indicates that you will go back to your first character. Don't let that irritate you. Just follow the instructions as shown above
- Pins might be inaccurate in the first few hours of a new Boss!


Every Pinned message is tested with a 10 Character Account! 

If a Pinned message does not give you 5 Skulls it means you need to work on your Account **->** Skilling levels, Class level, Material Capacity and Number of Kills are the requirements a Boss can have!

***Trophies and Shop***

The Weekly Boss has 5 Difficulties indicated by the 5 Skulls. 
Each skull beaten gives Trophies: Skull 1: 6 Trophies; Skull 2, 3, 4: 7 Trophies each; Skull 5: 8 Trophies
*Note:* You only get those Skulls one time each week

Additional Trophies can be obtained by choosing Misc options during Bossfights! 
- Not every week will have a good way to farm Trophies

**Shop:**
*Best Items to buy:*
- Gold Pocketwatch for 30 Trophies -> This item gives you all benefits of a daily reset
- **Trophy Star Talent Book** for 25 Trophies -> The Star Talent gives you Drop rate for each skull you beat this Week
*Note:* Other Items can be bought, but are not optimal

mostly in seeing how you solve things like this.. which algo is used, how it's set up. I'm thinking it's something to do with a weighted search tree or something of that nature?

The trophy/misc run is a basic depth first search with pruning (depth first to keep memory usage down, pruning states that are "equivalent" to previously seen states). Pretty fast, I think the current implementation was at worst 10 seconds on a super intense week? (This *completely* ignores damage, it may happen to deal enough damage but the algorithm truly doesn't care.)

The damage run, that's a whole other beast. In fact, there are two:
- A standard BFS trying to find a 5 skull path, maximizing trophies. This, however, can be memory intensive and need to be aborted for complex/long weeks. (Remember that the search space grows exponentially every extra step. The search space grows exponentially every step, in general!)
  Druzzt has put in logic to try to avoid provably suboptimial choices to keep the search space smaller. This is enough for some weeks (this week is an example) but not others.
- A bizarre approach I came up with after a bunch of trial an error. I was trying some things with weighting and randomness but nothing was panning out for a while. Eventually I landed on *essentially* BFS with state pruning. Once the number of states to search exceeds a threshold, all candidate states are evaluated to try to find which ones are most likely to produce the best damage outcome. This is probabilistic, taking each candidate and completing it N times using an RNG, tracking the maximum amount of damage that was dealt. Then the top M candidates are kept for the next BFS iteration. Surprisingly enough, this converges on some pretty good runs most of the time, but it's very much not guaranteed! (This does *not* take into account the logic to avoid provably suboptimal choices, at least not yet. It probably could which would give it a further leg up and help it to find the best options more often.)

content:
very interesting- one keyword the video used here was that it made *intuitive* sense that modal learning exists, which is an exact wording I had thought of before watching this. however, of course, making sense intuitively does not mean there will be empirical evidence to back it up, as the video also goes over. 
to some degree however to relate this back to this exact scenario- the video is moreso making the claim that we are "all" types of learners and the more ways information is presented and the more repetition done the better, as well as there logically better ways to present certain information (geography is a given for visual) and the argument can still be made that having a visual would aid with figuring out what to do.
i once more don't really know how the text description isn't enough (say to figure out what 1 and 2 and 3 means for attacking the boss, that seems pretty straightforward to me) and im not trying to discredit the work put in and all the effort put into the guide, i was mostly just trying to say that a visual would help some of these people and cause there to be less questions about it in this chat. interesting video regardless.

i also wanted to throw out the idea of audio processing disorder / dyslexia- on the topic of "visual vs auditory vs tactile learning all being the same for everyone," we could have some exclusions for certain people with conditions like APD or dyslexic people etc. just thought i'd throw that out there too, as my original message indicated that my intent was also focused on increasing accessibility.
